s1_headline: We've ruined pizza reaching for the wrong hard cheese.
s2_headline: Pecorino and Parmigiano are not interchangeable.
s2_subline: Swapping one for the other mid-recipe is not a neutral move.
s3_headline: Pecorino under a broiler turns sharp into harsh.
s3_subline: It's a finishing cheese only — added after the bake, never before.
s4_headline: Always grate it fresh, never from a canister.
s4_subline: Pre-grated versions are drier and saltier and won't behave the same.
